contents.text: Whom does a Lakeside technician call when a seal-water line can't be isolated?

A Lakeside technician calls the Lakeside shift supervisor on extension 6102 before work starts. A Riverside technician calls the Riverside maintenance planner on extension 4410 before work starts. A Northgate technician calls the Northgate maintenance planner on extension 5417 before work starts.

Safety bulletin SB-0932: Seal housing work (Lakeside plant) › Safety bulletin SB-0932: Seal housing work
Issued after a near miss at the Riverside plant in 2026, when a seal housing was opened on a pump that was still under seal-water pressure.
Apply lockout/tagout (LOTO) to the motor and isolate the seal-water and process lines before opening any CP-200 seal housing.
Verify zero energy before work starts.
This bulletin applies to every pump with a mechanical seal flushed by seal water, not only to the CP-200.
At the Lakeside plant, report any seal-water line that can't be isolated or drained to the Lakeside shift supervisor on extension 6102 before work starts.

SOP-FS-007: Pump isolation and lockout › Seal-water valves at Riverside
## Seal-water valves at Riverside
At the Riverside plant, the seal-water valve for each pump carries the pump's tag with the prefix V: valve V-114 feeds pump P-201.
